findings.title: Adding the first series does not apply the current visible range
findings.description: Description: The range effect runs when `mount.ready` changes, but at that point the chart has no series and the effect returns. Adding a series only increments `seriesCountRef` through the facade; it does not trigger a render or rerun this effect. As a result, the current range is not applied when the first series is added unless the range changes afterward. The translation test changes the range after adding a series, so it does not cover this case.

findings.title: Later operation failures replace the documented first error
findings.description: Description: `UseChartProviderResult.error` is documented as the first error, but `setOperationError` overwrites it on every failure. If multiple provider operations fail, the reported error is the latest one, not the first. Preserve the existing error when one is already set, or change the documented contract.
